verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents its own automation surface: a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support on macOS. Nothing shows Ghostty itself scheduling, triggering, or running those automations unattended in the background; that would depend on external tools. The systemd always-on integration only keeps the app running, not automations. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automations, autonomous background execution, Linux-side automation equivalents, hands-on corroboration of the scripting features.
